leaves.name: shimuraThm54Biholo
leaves.doc: Shimura 1971 (Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions) Thm 5.4, the main theorem of complex multiplication, with 'analytic isomorphism C/a -> E(C)' read as a biholomorphism of complex manifolds (IsAnalyticIso: fibres the cosets of kappa(a), onto, Mathlib IsLocalDiffeomorph I(C) I(C) omega for the complex structure on E(C) = E.toAffine.Point given by the charts x, y, t = -x/y and the one-point-compactification topology): for xi : C/a -> E(C) an analytic isomorphism with xi(0) = O there is an analytic isomorphism xi' : C/s^-1 a -> E^sigma(C) with xi(u)^sigma = xi'(s^-1 u) for u in K/a. Weaker than or equal to the print in either reading of 'analytic isomorphism' (with or without the group law): hypothesis restricted to xi(0) = O, no group law asked of xi', uniqueness dropped, short Weierstrass models only.
leaves.flag: pending reading: R2 (Shimura 5.2 defines s^-1 a; the Lean sInvLat uses K cap s_f^-1 closure(a) in the finite adeles; equal to the localization definition by the lattice lemma of task hcm-lattice, not yet in Lean); G1 (clause form vs analytic isomorphism) proved in Lean by hcm-weierstrass (isAnalyticUnif_iff_isAnalyticIso_zero); locator UNVERIFIED (numbers)
